detail.zh-Hant: 由小鼠白色脂肪分離米色脂肪細胞：基礎 UCP1 低，cAMP 刺激後 UCP1 同呼吸率上升；人類棕色脂肪沉積與米色細胞相似

detail.en: Review of brown and beige fat: beige cells develop in white fat in response to various activators
detail.zh-Hant: 棕色同米色脂肪綜述：米色細胞喺多種活化因子作用下於白色脂肪中形成

detail.en: Review of procollagen trafficking through the secretory pathway, conversion to collagen by procollagen metalloproteinases and fibril formation
detail.zh-Hant: 前膠原經分泌途徑運輸、由前膠原金屬蛋白酶轉變為膠原，以及纖維形成嘅綜述

detail.en: Review of fibroblasts as the most common connective tissue cell and principal source of extracellular matrix; contractile myofibroblasts
detail.zh-Hant: 纖維母細胞係最常見嘅結締組織細胞同細胞外基質嘅主要來源；收縮性肌纖維母細胞綜述

detail.en: Review of osteocyte functions: orchestrating bone remodelling through osteoblasts and osteoclasts, endocrine signalling, long life within mineralised matrix
detail.zh-Hant: 骨細胞功能綜述：透過成骨細胞同破骨細胞調控骨重塑、內分泌訊號，以及喺礦化基質內長壽

schaffler-2014.source: Schaffler et al. (2014) Calcif Tissue Int 94:5–24

detail.en: Review of osteocytes entombed in mineralised matrix, networked through gap junctions and the lacunar-canalicular system, sensing mechanical signals
detail.zh-Hant: 困於礦化基質中嘅骨細胞，透過間隙連接同骨陷窩-骨小管系統組成網絡並感測機械訊號嘅綜述

detail.en: Sclerostin, expressed in osteocytes, is a BMP antagonist that suppresses osteoblast activity and bone formation
detail.zh-Hant: 骨細胞表達嘅硬化蛋白係 BMP 拮抗劑，抑制成骨細胞活性同骨形成

clarke-2008.source: Clarke (2008) Clin J Am Soc Nephrol 3:S131–S139

detail.en: Review of normal bone anatomy and physiology: collagenous and non-collagenous matrix proteins, mineralisation, and the canalicular network
detail.zh-Hant: 正常骨骼解剖同生理綜述：膠原同非膠原基質蛋白、礦化，以及骨小管網絡

schneeberger-2004.source: Schneeberger & Lynch (2004) Am J Physiol Cell Physiol 286:C1213–C1228

detail.en: Review of the tight junction: occludin, claudins and junction adhesion molecules, plaque proteins, paracellular barrier and cell polarity
detail.zh-Hant: 緊密連接綜述：occludin、claudin 與連接黏附分子、斑塊蛋白、細胞旁屏障與細胞極性

detail.en: Review of adherens junction components: transmembrane adhesion receptors and their actin-binding and regulatory partners
detail.zh-Hant: 黏著連接組成綜述：跨膜黏附受體及其肌動蛋白結合與調節蛋白

simpson-2011.source: Simpson, Patel & Green (2011) Nat Rev Mol Cell Biol 12:565–580

detail.en: Review of cell junctions and the cytoskeleton in the epidermis, and how keratinocytes reorganise them while moving toward the cornified layers
detail.zh-Hant: 表皮細胞連接與細胞骨架綜述，及角質形成細胞向角質層移動時如何重組

detail.en: Review of connexins, the gap junction proteins: channel assembly, short half-lives, turnover and disease-linked mutations
detail.zh-Hant: 連接蛋白（間隙連接蛋白）綜述：通道組裝、半衰期短、更新及與疾病相關的突變

detail.en: Review of hemidesmosomes: α6β4 integrin, attachment of epithelial cells to the basement membrane, assembly and blistering diseases
detail.zh-Hant: 半橋粒綜述：α6β4 整合素、上皮細胞與基底膜的附著、組裝及水皰病

detail.en: Basement membrane cords contain collagen IV, laminin, heparan sulfate proteoglycan, entactin and fibronectin. Mixing collagen IV, laminin and proteoglycan in vitro forms sheets like the lamina densa
detail.zh-Hant: 基底膜的索狀結構含 IV 型膠原蛋白、層黏連蛋白、硫酸肝素蛋白聚醣、entactin 與纖連蛋白。體外混合 IV 型膠原蛋白、層黏連蛋白與蛋白聚醣可形成類似緻密層的薄片

leblond-1989.method: Electron microscopy and in vitro assembly

torricelli-2013.source: Torricelli et al. (2013) Invest Ophthalmol Vis Sci 54:6390

detail.en: Review of the corneal epithelial basement membrane between basal epithelial cells and stroma: collagens, laminins, heparan sulfate proteoglycans and nidogens
detail.zh-Hant: 角膜上皮基底膜綜述：位於基底上皮細胞與基質之間，由膠原蛋白、層黏連蛋白、硫酸肝素蛋白聚醣與 nidogen 組成

detail.en: Review of 9+2 motile and 9+0 primary cilia: structure from electron microscopy, sensory and signalling roles
detail.zh-Hant: 9+2 運動纖毛與 9+0 初級纖毛綜述：電子顯微鏡所見結構、感覺與訊號傳遞功能

schwander-2010.source: Schwander, Kachar & Müller (2010) J Cell Biol 190:9–20

detail.en: Review of inner-ear hair cells, which convert sound-induced vibrations into electrical signals, and deafness genes that control their development
detail.zh-Hant: 內耳毛細胞綜述：毛細胞把聲音振動轉成電訊號，及控制其發育的失聰基因

karttunen-1989.source: Karttunen, Sormunen & Risteli (1989) J Histochem Cytochem 37:279–286

detail.en: Reticular fibres of normal human lymph nodes contain type III collagen with its amino terminal pro-peptide, plus laminin and type IV collagen
detail.zh-Hant: 正常人類淋巴結的網狀纖維含保留胺基端前肽的 III 型膠原蛋白，以及層黏連蛋白與 IV 型膠原蛋白

detail.en: Review of proteoglycans in connective tissue matrices: glycosaminoglycans give hydration and swelling pressure, and proteoglycans regulate collagen fibril formation
detail.zh-Hant: 結締組織基質中蛋白聚醣綜述：糖胺聚醣提供水合與膨壓，蛋白聚醣調節膠原纖維形成

dasilva-2014.source: da Silva et al. (2014) J Histochem Cytochem 62:698–738

detail.en: Review of mast cell function: first responders at the host-environment interface that release biologically active mediators in allergy and in innate and adaptive immunity
detail.zh-Hant: 肥大細胞功能綜述：位於宿主與外界界面的第一線反應細胞，在過敏及先天與適應性免疫中釋出生物活性介質

detail.en: Review of surface markers of human mesenchymal stem cells (Stro-1, SSEA-4, CD271, CD146) and their possible fibroblast or pericyte origin
detail.zh-Hant: 人類間質幹細胞表面標記（Stro-1、SSEA-4、CD271、CD146）及其可能的纖維母細胞或周細胞來源綜述

detail.en: Review of the OXPHOS system: the electron transport chain is four multimeric enzymes and two mobile electron carriers, and it makes the proton motive force that complex V uses to make ATP
detail.zh-Hant: 氧化磷酸化系統綜述：電子傳遞鏈由四個多聚體酶與兩個移動電子載體組成，產生質子動力，供複合體 V 合成 ATP

michel-1998.source: Michel, Behr & Harrenga (1998) Annu Rev Biophys Biomol Struct 27:329–356

detail.en: Review of cytochrome c oxidase: it passes electrons from cytochrome c to oxygen, reducing it to water, and the transfer is coupled to proton translocation across the membrane
detail.zh-Hant: 細胞色素 c 氧化酶綜述：把電子由細胞色素 c 傳給氧並還原成水，電子傳遞與質子跨膜轉運偶聯

jonckheere-2012.source: Jonckheere, Smeitink & Rodenburg (2012) J Inherit Metab Dis 35:211–225

detail.en: Review of human mitochondrial ATP synthase (complex V): F1 in the matrix, Fo in the inner membrane, and the proton electrochemical gradient drives ADP phosphorylation
detail.zh-Hant: 人類線粒體 ATP 合酶（複合體 V）綜述：F1 位於基質，Fo 位於內膜，質子電化學梯度驅動 ADP 磷酸化

detail.en: Review of intestinal sugar transport: amylases digest starch, brush border disaccharidases (lactase-phloridzin hydrolase, sucrase-isomaltase) make monosaccharides, and enterocyte transporters take them up
detail.zh-Hant: 腸道糖類轉運綜述：澱粉酶消化澱粉，刷狀緣雙糖酶（乳糖酶-根皮苷水解酶、蔗糖酶-異麥芽糖酶）生成單糖，腸細胞轉運蛋白將其吸收

detail.en: Review of SGLT1 and SGLT2: SGLT1 accounts for most dietary glucose uptake in the intestine, and SLC5A1 mutations cause glucose/galactose malabsorption
detail.zh-Hant: SGLT1 與 SGLT2 綜述：SGLT1 負責腸道大部分膳食葡萄糖吸收，SLC5A1 突變導致葡萄糖／半乳糖吸收不良

wright-2007.source: Wright, Hirayama & Loo (2007) J Intern Med 261:32–43

detail.en: Review of secondary active glucose transport by SGLT1 and SGLT2 in intestinal glucose absorption and renal reabsorption
detail.zh-Hant: SGLT1 與 SGLT2 繼發性主動葡萄糖轉運綜述：腸道葡萄糖吸收與腎臟重吸收

smith-2013.source: Smith, Clémençon & Hediger (2013) Mol Aspects Med 34:323–336

detail.en: Review of the SLC15 peptide transporters: PepT1 takes up di- and tripeptides by proton-coupled symport and absorbs dietary protein digestion products in the intestine
detail.zh-Hant: SLC15 肽轉運蛋白綜述：PepT1 以質子偶聯同向轉運吸收二肽與三肽，負責腸道吸收膳食蛋白質消化產物

miner-williams-2014.source: Miner-Williams, Stevens & Moughan (2014) Nutr Res Rev 27:308–329

detail.en: Review of peptide absorption: di- and tripeptides enter the enterocyte through PepT1, most are hydrolysed in the cytosol, and little evidence shows longer peptides entering the hepatic portal system intact
detail.zh-Hant: 肽吸收綜述：二肽與三肽經 PepT1 進入腸細胞，大部分在細胞質內水解，較長的肽完整進入肝門脈系統的證據不多

iqbal-2009.source: Iqbal & Hussain (2009) Am J Physiol Endocrinol Metab 296:E1183–E1194

detail.en: Review of intestinal lipid absorption: uptake of hydrolysis products, resynthesis into neutral lipids in the endoplasmic reticulum, assembly of apoB lipoproteins (chylomicrons) and export into the lymphatic system
detail.zh-Hant: 腸道脂質吸收綜述：水解產物的攝取、在內質網重新合成中性脂質、組裝 apoB 脂蛋白（乳糜微粒）並輸出至淋巴系統

detail.en: Review of organ-specific lymphatic vasculature, including the mechanisms that control dietary fat uptake by intestinal lacteals
detail.zh-Hant: 器官特異性淋巴管綜述，包括控制小腸乳糜管吸收膳食脂肪的機制

detail.en: Review of apoptosis, programmed cell death: its morphology, biochemistry, role in health and disease, and detection methods
detail.zh-Hant: 細胞凋亡（程序性細胞死亡）綜述：形態、生化、在健康與疾病中的角色及檢測方法

scaffidi-1999.source: Scaffidi et al. (1999) J Biol Chem 274:22532–22538

detail.en: In CD95 (Fas) type I cells, active caspase-8 formed at the DISC directly cleaves caspase-3. In type II cells, little DISC forms and the mitochondrial branch is engaged through BID cleavage, which Bcl-2 or Bcl-xL can block
detail.zh-Hant: 在 CD95（Fas）I 型細胞中，DISC 形成的活性 caspase-8 直接切割 caspase-3；在 II 型細胞中，DISC 很少，經 BID 切割啟動線粒體分支，而 Bcl-2 或 Bcl-xL 可阻斷

micheau-2002.source: Micheau et al. (2002) J Biol Chem 277:45162–45171

detail.en: Death ligands such as FasL bind Fas, which recruits the adaptor FADD and the initiator caspases-8 and -10 to form the death-inducing signaling complex (DISC), where procaspase-8 is activated by cleavage
detail.zh-Hant: FasL 等死亡配體結合 Fas，招募接合蛋白 FADD 及啟動型 caspase-8 與 -10，形成死亡誘導訊號複合體（DISC），procaspase-8 在此經切割而活化

detail.en: Review of how BCL-2 family proteins control mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP): BH3-only proteins engage BAX and BAK and neutralise anti-apoptotic BCL-2 proteins
detail.zh-Hant: BCL-2 家族蛋白如何控制線粒體外膜通透化（MOMP）綜述：僅含 BH3 的蛋白啟動 BAX 與 BAK，並中和抗凋亡的 BCL-2 蛋白

detail.en: Review of MOMP, which defines the mitochondrial (intrinsic) pathway: cytochrome c and SMAC release lead to caspase activation and protein substrate cleavage, under control of the BCL-2 family
detail.zh-Hant: MOMP 綜述，MOMP 定義線粒體（內在）途徑：細胞色素 c 與 SMAC 釋出，導致 caspase 活化及蛋白底物被切割，並受 BCL-2 家族控制

garrido-2006.source: Garrido et al. (2006) Cell Death Differ 13:1423–1433

detail.en: Review of cytochrome c release from mitochondria: in the cytosol it activates Apaf-1, which is required for maturation of caspase-9 and caspase-3, and activated caspases dismantle the cell
detail.zh-Hant: 細胞色素 c 由線粒體釋出綜述：在細胞質中它活化 Apaf-1，而 Apaf-1 是 caspase-9 與 caspase-3 成熟所必需，活化的 caspase 其後拆解細胞

detail.en: Review of apoptosomes: the Apaf-1 apoptosome is the adaptor protein complex that activates the initiator caspase-9, as the DISC does for caspase-8
detail.zh-Hant: 凋亡體綜述：Apaf-1 凋亡體是活化啟動型 caspase-9 的接合蛋白複合體，與 DISC 活化 caspase-8 的角色相似

pajak-2019.source: Pająk et al. (2019) Int J Mol Sci 21:234

detail.en: Review of 2-deoxy-D-glucose, with an overview of glucose metabolism: glycolysis turns glucose into two pyruvate and a net 2 ATP, pyruvate is oxidised to acetyl-CoA by the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex, the Krebs cycle yields NADH and FADH2, and the respiratory chain reoxidises them
detail.zh-Hant: 2-脫氧-D-葡萄糖綜述，並概述葡萄糖代謝：糖解把葡萄糖變成兩個丙酮酸並淨得 2 個 ATP，丙酮酸經丙酮酸脫氫酶複合體氧化成乙醯輔酶 A，克雷布斯循環產生 NADH 與 FADH₂，再由呼吸鏈氧化回復

gray-2013.source: Gray, Tompkins & Taylor (2013) Cell Mol Life Sci 71:2577–2604

detail.en: Review of pyruvate metabolism: pyruvate is the end product of glycolysis and is transported into mitochondria (by the mitochondrial pyruvate carrier) as a fuel input for citric acid cycle carbon flux, with pyruvate dehydrogenase as a regulated step
detail.zh-Hant: 丙酮酸代謝綜述：丙酮酸是糖解的終產物，經線粒體丙酮酸載體運入線粒體，作為檸檬酸循環碳流的燃料，丙酮酸脫氫酶是受調控的一步

saunier-2015.source: Saunier et al. (2015) Int J Cancer 138:809–817

detail.en: Review of the pyruvate dehydrogenase complex, which links glycolysis to the Krebs cycle by irreversible decarboxylation of pyruvate into acetyl-CoA, regulated by PDK and PDP phosphorylation
detail.zh-Hant: 丙酮酸脫氫酶複合體綜述：它把丙酮酸不可逆地脫羧成乙醯輔酶 A，連接糖解與克雷布斯循環，並受 PDK 與 PDP 的磷酸化調控

detail.en: Review of the tricarboxylic acid (TCA) cycle as a central route for oxidative phosphorylation that meets bioenergetic, biosynthetic and redox needs
detail.zh-Hant: 三羧酸（TCA）循環綜述：它是氧化磷酸化的核心途徑，滿足能量、生物合成及氧化還原的需求

detail.en: Review of mitochondrial metabolism: mitochondria catabolise nutrients for energy, make biosynthetic precursors and compartmentalise metabolites
detail.zh-Hant: 線粒體代謝綜述：線粒體分解養分以產生能量、製造生物合成前體，並把代謝物分隔
